title: Irish Hash with Spinach
description: A hearty and flavorful Irish-inspired dish made with crispy hash browns, fresh spinach, and a hint of northern charm.
instructions: Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish with butter.
In a large bowl, combine the hash browns, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Spread the hash brown mixture evenly into the prepared baking dish.
Drizzle the remaining butter over the top of the hash browns.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the hash browns are crispy and golden brown.
While the hash browns are baking, heat a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped spinach to the skillet and cook until wilted, about 3-5 minutes.
Remove the skillet from the heat and set aside.
Once the hash browns are done, remove them from the oven and top with the wilted spinach.
